themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, engage with systems, or act on behalf of users in research contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, testing, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discussions and reviews of AI-powered platforms and applications designed to aid in various research activities, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles exploring the use of AI-generated or simulated users for testing, research, or training purposes, comparing them with human participants.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Content about using AI to automate software testing processes, improve quality assurance, and accelerate testing cycles.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Research and analysis concerning the capabilities, limitations, user interactions, and ethical implications of AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores AI applications directly assisting in the design process and the research activities that inform design decisions.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Studies and reports on how AI is affecting job markets, employment, skills demand, and the future of work.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that directly compare the performance, features, and effectiveness of different AI-powered research tools and platforms.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is leveraged to gather, analyze, and derive actionable insights from customer data and interactions.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
